exposure: Lidocaine spray (8 puffs of 10% lidocaine, 80 mg)
outcome: Pain reduction (measured by 10-cm visual analog scale)
cohort: Pregnant women in their second trimester (15-20 weeks gestation) who underwent amniocentesis.
finding: Lidocaine spray significantly reduced pain during amniocentesis and 15 and 30 minutes after the procedure compared to oral paracetamol and a control group, while paracetamol showed no significant difference from the control.
